# Reference-Class Awards Admission Instrument v1

Status: `PREACTIVATION_CANDIDATE`

This package defines the missing fail-closed boundary between universal page/product excellence and competitive awards evaluation.

The three questions are intentionally distinct:

1. Page Excellence: is the candidate professionally resolved and operationally excellent?
2. Reference-Class Awards Admission: is the rendered, functioning work mature enough to enter an awards-quality comparison at all?
3. Awards Evaluation: how does an already-admissible work perform against the applicable award criteria?

The admission instrument does not award points for the mere presence of ingredients. It judges whether the rendered and interacted-with whole resolves into an authored, coherent, professionally mature experience comparable in maturity to the relevant accepted reference class.

Reference parity means maturity parity, not stylistic imitation.

Calibration begins with three positive reference classes: the Laws six-authority Compass spatial instrument, the accepted H-Earth live experience, and the accepted Audralia planetary globe/world experience. The failed Phi1 manifestation at commit `8f3bafbe200c92ac804a979eab6a708bc73997d3` is a negative calibration control only.

Terminal candidate dispositions are `AWARDS_CONVERSATION_ADMISSIBLE`, `BELOW_AWARDS_CONVERSATION`, and `UNEVALUABLE`. Catastrophic defects are noncompensatory: strengths elsewhere cannot average away a failure that destroys the integrity of the whole.

This pre-activation package creates no awards result, named-award readiness claim, product acceptance, mutation authority over Page Excellence/H-Earth/Laws, merge authority, or production enforcement. Activation requires a separate post-calibration ratification operation.
